'''CT-EX''', known as '''Teex''', was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] serving aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']]. After being reprogrammed by ship thief [[Cryle Cavv]], CT-EX helped him reprogram the vessel's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to leap into [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] territory, ultimately allowing the Republic to capture the ''Guardian''.
